_comment: Whole-word case-insensitive substitution applied BEFORE TTS. Two valid use cases: (1) English words in a VN script that the model mispronounces — replace with VN-phonetic spelling (e.g. 'doc' -> 'đóc' so model says /dɒk/). (2) Vietnamese proper nouns written without diacritics in source — replace with proper VN spelling so model reads them correctly (e.g. 'Hanoi' -> 'Hà Nội'). Keep entries that are clearly safe (low collision risk). Never add common English words that could rewrite brand names (don't add 'code' — would clobber 'Claude Code'). Curate by listening.
